## About
Qualitek Auto Body is a local body shop on South Congress in South Austin. We fix collision damage, dents, fenders and hail damage on foreign and domestic vehicles of all makes and models.
If you've just been in an accident, we know it's stressful. We'll look over your car, give you an honest evaluation of the costs, and work with your insurance company on the paperwork. One reviewer called us a longtime, local Austin, family-owned business.
We're rated 4.8 from 154 Google reviews. Stop by the shop or give us a call, and we'll take a look.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs and paint work after an accident, for foreign and domestic vehicles of all makes and models.
- Paintless dent repair: A range of paintless dent repairs at affordable prices, done with good equipment.
- Fender and hail damage repair: We fix damaged fenders and hail damage for drivers around Austin.
- Towing: Towing is available along with your repairs. Ask us about it when you call.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. Our team can work with your insurance company and handle the paperwork for you.

Q: Do you charge for estimates?
A: No. Estimates are free. Stop by the shop or give us a call.

Q: What kinds of vehicles do you repair?
A: We do collision repairs on foreign and domestic vehicles of all makes and models.

Q: Are you open on the weekend?
A: Yes, on Saturday from 9:00 AM to 2:00 PM. We're closed on Sunday.
